title: GA-NIFS: The core of an extremely massive protocluster at the epoch of reionisation probed with JWST/NIRSpec
question: Characterise the environment, dynamical state, and interstellar medium (ISM) properties within the SPT0311-58 system at z ~ 6.9 using JWST/NIRSpec Integral Field Unit spectroscopy and ancillary data.

data.angular_resolution: 0.09 x 0.08 arcsec^2 (continuum); 0.08 x 0.07 arcsec^2 ([C II] cube)
data.sensitivity: 9.4 uJy beam^-1 (continuum); ~150 uJy beam^-1 in a 20 km s^-1 channel ([C II])

what.value: JWST/MIRI 10 um image, Pa-alpha emission line fluxes, FIR/submm photometry, and stellar mass of the W galaxy

evidence.quote: The image of SPT0311-58 obtained with MIRI at 10 µm and published by Álvarez-Márquez et al. (2023) was kindly provided to us by the MIRI GTO team.

Therefore, we adopt the stellar mass recently derived by Álvarez-Márquez et al. (2023), which is based on a CIGALE SED fit using HST/WFC3, JWST/MIRI, HERSCHEL/SPIRE, and ALMA photometry and the Paα emission line flux.

what.value: Lensing magnification factor (mu = 2.2) for galaxy W, and total SFR/mass estimates for comparison

evidence.quote: Since source W is multiply imaged, it was not included in this simple analysis, and we adopt the magnification factor of Marrone et al. (2018) instead.

recipe.goal: Reduce JWST/NIRSpec IFU cubes, register astrometry, and image ALMA data
recipe.method: Reduce NIRSpec R100 and R2700 cubes with modified JWST pipeline v1.8.2 (drizzle, 0.05 arcsec spaxels), align astrometry to HST F125W and Gaia DR3, subtract median sky from R100, and image/regrid ALMA Band 6 continuum and [C II] cubes to 0.05 arcsec spaxels with moment maps.
key_parameters: spaxel scale = 0.05 arcsec; [C II] integration range = -1000 to +1200 km s^-1 (w.r.t. z=6.900); S/N threshold for [C II] moment 1 and 2 = 2.3

recipe.goal: Identify sources, extract spectra, fit emission lines, and model gravitational lensing
recipe.method: Collapse R100 cube in continuum and line bands to identify sources, extract aperture spectra, fit Gaussian emission line profiles to R100 and R2700 spectra (including 2-Gaussian kinematic decomposition for E and L7), fit low-z galaxy photo-z with EAZY, and model lens magnification with PyAutoLens.
key_parameters: 10% flux reduction applied to R100 fluxes; circular Gaussian PSF FWHM = 0.1 arcsec for lens modelling
assumptions: Isothermal ellipsoid mass profile for lens with same centroid, axis ratio, and PA as light profile; mu = 2.2 for galaxy W from Marrone et al. (2018)

recipe.goal: Derive stellar masses, dust attenuation, metallicities, and star formation rates
recipe.method: Fit R100 spectra with Bruzual & Charlot (2003) models and CIGALE to derive stellar masses; compute A_V from H-alpha/H-beta and Pa-alpha/H-alpha; infer gas-phase metallicities via MCMC using Curti et al. (2017, 2020b) calibrations; and compute H-alpha SFRs.
key_parameters: Intrinsic (H-alpha/H-beta)_int = 2.79; SFR(H-alpha) = 5.37e-42 L(H-alpha) with 0.5 factor for metal-poor galaxies C2, L1-L5
assumptions: Kroupa (2001) IMF; Calzetti et al. (2000) attenuation law; Case B recombination (T_e = 10000 K, n_e = 100 cm^-3); H0 = 67.7 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.307, Omega_Lambda = 0.691

recipe.goal: Determine galaxy kinematics, dynamical masses, and protocluster halo properties
recipe.method: Compute galaxy dynamical masses from R2700 [O III] velocity dispersions and 2D Gaussian effective radii; compare NIRSpec [O III] and ALMA [C II] kinematics; estimate protocluster dark-matter halo mass M_h and R_200 from total stellar mass; and test virialisation via K-S test, bootstrap cluster velocity dispersion, and projected phase space diagram.
key_parameters: Virial factor K = 5 +/- 0.1; M_star / M_h = 0.015 - 0.03; systemic redshift z_sys = 6.902 (at W galaxy)
assumptions: NFW dark-matter halo profile; 0.4 dex stellar mass reduction for sources without MIRI photometry following Papovich et al. (2023) and Wang et al. (2024)
